summary: what this machine has and what it still needs — bare reports, sync installs what is the repos to install

explanation.machine: its own name for itself - never shared, never transported; the Signature names it and capture addresses the store by it

tools.jq: every pipeline's json work runs through it
tools.python3: the one python3 that survives (#478): it mints the venv, and everything else runs the venv's python
tools.pyright: corpus-yoga test run type-checks src/ against pyrightconfig.json with it
tools.shellcheck: corpus-yoga test run lints every src/**/*.sh with it
tools.docker: corpus-yoga test run reproduces the mcp snapshot through upstream's generator (mcp.reproducible); corpus-yoga mcp reproduce runs it alone
tools.antlr4 and java: corpus-yoga grammar sync generates the parsers with them, and corpus-yoga test run holds the parsers current (grammar.parser_current)

explanation.venv: the one interpreter every .py target runs in; VENV= names another
explanation.python requirements: what corpus-yoga pipeline run needs, by its manifest src/requirements.txt
explanation.markdown viewer render libs: what corpus-yoga server renders with, by its manifest src/main/model/serve_assets.txt
explanation.corpus-yoga CLI: its tables are src/main/cli/, and the completions are generated from them
explanation.git: the tool, and the identity a commit requires
explanation.pre-commit hook: the repo's commit gate: until installed, nothing vets a commit
explanation.signature hook: stamps Signature: machine/provider/session on a commit, and strips the model co-author
explanation.forge settings: declared in src/main/cli/forge/forge.csv; server-side, so unverifiable offline
explanation.pipeline inputs: this repo ships no data; a room supplies its own, and each pipeline reads its store under data/input
explanation.live stores: each provider's own store of its sessions, harness-owned and expiring at the provider's will, read through a mount, ext/mnt/agent/<provider>
explanation.deploy: ext/mnt/site, the site repo's clone, which corpus-yoga site's tree copies to; only a deploying machine needs it
explanation.stage: tmp/stage/input: what this room has captured and not yet promoted
explanation.migration: rsc/migration: the moves a rename owes this machine's local roots, each a guarded script run once

args.name: --show-all
args.help: show the full report, including satisfied (✓) items (default: only what needs attention)
